title: A message queued during a foreground subagent behaves oddly
body:
When the main agent starts a background subagent and then waits on it, the Claude adapter leaves the turn's `session/prompt` unanswered until the subagent ends (memory `claude-adapter-holds-turns-for-subagents`). A prompt Jack sends meanwhile goes out at once (coax-765bf0) and sits in the queued row. Claude Code hands a queued prompt to the model only with the next tool result (memory `claude-adapter-queues-prompts`), and an agent waiting on a subagent produces none. So the message waits until the subagent finishes, which can take minutes.

## Proposal

coax advertises `backgroundSubagents` among its `jetbrains.air` meta capabilities in `Link::initialize`. The adapter then ends a turn while its subagents still run, so the next prompt starts a new turn at once.

## Cost

- The adapter starts turns of its own, for example when a subagent finishes and the main agent reacts, with no `session/prompt` behind them. coax must show updates that arrive outside a turn, and the working line and the decade report must treat such a turn as working.
- The `jetbrains.air` namespace is JetBrains' extension. Advertising one capability from it may make the adapter expect more of that protocol, which needs reading in the adapter's bundled JavaScript before the change.
- The fake agent needs a scenario step that starts an update stream with no prompt, to test it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bd10c4a0
notes.text: Debug log of 2026-11-11, 04:23 UTC: with a background subagent running, Jack's prompt `okay` went out at 04:23:40.129 and the adapter ended the held turn at 04:23:41.137, so Claude Code took the prompt within a second. Background subagents do not stall a message. The stalls earlier in the day came during foreground subagents, which are one long tool call, and Claude Code hands a queued message to the model only at the next tool result. Jack ruled out the `jetbrains.air` route. He still sees odd behaviour from a message queued against a foreground subagent, to be tested once coax-47019c lands.
